title: Predictors and Orchestrators: Parsimonious Machine Learning within an Agentic AI Harness for Multi-Horizon Karst Aquifer Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.22251v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Forecasting karst aquifer dynamics is difficult because recharge responses are nonlinear, event-driven, and governed by strongly heterogeneous flow paths. This study develops and evaluates a deployment-aware framework for 1-12-week-ahead prediction of spring discharge and groundwater level using approximately 79 years of hydroclimatic observations from the Edwards Aquifer, Texas. Five model families were compared under a common temporal evaluation design: extreme gradient boosting, extremely randomized trees, long short-term memory, convolutional neural networks, and Transformers. Predictions were evaluated using coefficient of determination, Kling-Gupta efficiency, root-mean-square error, and agreement with operational drought thresholds. translated_title: 预测器与编排器：智能体AI框架内用于多时间尺度岩溶含水层预测的简约机器学习
translated_abstract: 预测岩溶含水层动态十分困难，因为补给响应是非线性的、事件驱动的，且受强烈非均质流动路径的控制。本研究开发并评估了一个面向部署的框架，利用德克萨斯州爱德华兹含水层约79年的水文气候观测数据，对泉水流量和地下水位进行1-12周前瞻预测。在统一的时间评估设计下，研究比较了五种模型家族：极端梯度提升、极端随机树、长短期记忆网络、卷积神经网络和Transformer。预测结果采用决定系数、Kling-Gupta效率系数、均方根误差以及与运行干旱阈值的一致性进行评估。结果表明，极端梯度提升始终最为可靠，在1-4周、5-8周和9-12周预测尺度上R²分别至少达到0.97、0.96和0.94，且在关键阶段的一致性超过90%。
tldr: 该研究构建了一个面向部署的智能体AI框架，通过对五种机器学习模型的系统比较，证明简约的极端梯度提升模型在爱德华兹含水层1-12周泉水流量与地下水位多时间尺度预测中最为可靠（R²≥0.94），且与运行干旱阈值高度一致。
en_tdlr: This study develops a deployment-aware agentic AI framework demonstrating that parsimonious extreme gradient boosting is the most reliable model for 1-12-week-ahead forecasting of spring discharge and groundwater levels in the Edwards Aquifer, achieving R² ≥ 0.94 across all horizons with over 90% agreement with operational drought thresholds.
